description: This file defines a Spring configuration class that sets up caching for the Fineract application, using a SimpleCacheManager with several ConcurrentMapCache instances for different cache regions.

classes.name: CacheConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that enables caching and defines a CacheManager bean with specific cache regions.

methods.name: cacheManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a SimpleCacheManager instance configured with multiple ConcurrentMapCache instances for different cache regions.
